Finding the right breast pump shouldn't be complicated. At Momcozy, we've helped over 3 million mothers in 60+ countries on their breastfeeding journeys. We know every mom needs something different:
exclusively pumping moms need power, working moms need discretion, and new moms need comfort
.

This

Momcozy breast pump comparison guide

walks through our full lineup, which now spans five families: the

W Series

(warm-massage wearable),

Air Series

(ultra-slim wearable),

M Series

(smart wearables),

S Series

(classic wearables), and the

V Series

(hospital-grade pumps). The family now includes the new warm-massage

W1

and the hospital-grade

V3

(plug-in) and

V3 Pro

(cordless) — so whether you need a discreet pump for the office or strong suction at home, this Momcozy pump comparison has you covered.

How Many Breast Pump Models Does Momcozy Have?

To make choosing easier, we've organized our pumps into distinct families. Each series has a different design philosophy, but all are built to give you freedom, comfort, and the ability to "get back to feeling like yourself".

The W Series (W1)
:

Our comfort-forward family, launched with the W1 — the industry's first warm-massage wearable breast pump. Gentle heat and rhythmic massage work with suction to encourage let-down and comfort.

The Air 1 Series
: Our newest model, designed to be the slimmest and most discreet pump on the market.

The M Series (M5, M6, M9)
: These are our all-in-one comfort models, focusing on ergonomic design, gentle suction, and a "painless" pumping experience.

The S Series (S9 Pro, S12 Pro Quick)
: Our classic and beloved wearable pumps. These are the reliable workhorses of our collection, known for their efficiency and long battery life.

The V Series (V1 Pro, V2 Pro, V3, V3 Pro)
: Momcozy V series breast pumps have tubing to connect motor and milk collector.

The family now adds the plug-in hospital-grade

V3

and the cordless

V3 Pro

— both with Dual-Pump Dual-Control and five built-in rhythms.

Let's dive into a detailed Momcozy breast pump models comparison.

W1
, the industry's first warm-massage wearable breast pump — built for moms who want gentle warmth and soft rhythmic massage working alongside suction to encourage let-down and comfort.

Momcozy W1 — Warm-Massage Wearable Breast Pump

The

Momcozy W1

(model BP420) is a hands-free wearable pump with industry-first Warm-Massage Sync technology. Exclusive

HugWave™

wave rhythm and

SoftPulse™

massage deliver 3 levels of warmth (38–40°C) and 3 levels of rhythmic massage that sync with the pumping cycle. It reaches up to

across 12 levels (or 15 levels × 3 speeds in pro mode), holds

180 ml
, weighs

280 g
, and runs about

10 sessions per charge

(6 with warmth on). All settings — warmth, massage, mode, and milk tracking — live in the Momcozy app.

Design, Flange, and Milk Collector

The W1 is an all-in-one in-bra unit about 2.8" thick, with food-grade BPA-free silicone cups and a 24 mm flange plus 17/19/21 mm inserts for a snug fit. The 180 ml collector means fewer interruptions, and Type-C charging takes about 2.5 hours.

Motor, Suction, Modes, and Pumping Settings

Five modes cover the day: Warm-Massage Sync, Massage, Expression, Mixed, plus Milk Boost and Milk Relief. Suction tops out at 295 mmHg with 12 levels (or 15 × 3 speeds), and the motor stays under 50 dB. The app lets you fine-tune warmth and massage without breaking your rhythm.

What is Momcozy W1 best suitable for?

The W1 is ideal for moms with low or sluggish supply who benefit from warmth and massage, moms with sensitive or engorged breasts who want a gentler let-down, and anyone who wants app-controlled comfort during every wearable session. It pairs especially well with a hospital-grade pump at home for moms who need both comfort on the go and power at the nightstand.

Momcozy Air 1

The
Momcozy Air 1
was crafted for one primary purpose: ultimate discretion. It is the thinnest, most premium wearable pump we've ever designed, made for the mom who needs to pump absolutely anywhere without a second thought. It's the pump that is truly "in-bra, under the radar".

Design, Flange, and Milk Collector

The slim profile of the Air 1 is its defining feature, allowing it to be worn under clothing almost invisibly. But its design is about more than just aesthetics. We integrated a transparent top-view window, which solves one of the biggest challenges of
wearable pumps
: nipple alignment. You can look down and ensure perfect placement every time, optimizing efficiency and preventing discomfort.

The flanges are made from an incredibly soft 50A silicone, designed to gently conform to all breast shapes and sizes for a secure, comfortable, and leak-free fit.

Motor, Suction, Modes, and Pumping Settings

The Air 1 is as smart as it is sleek. It features an ultra-quiet motor that operates at less than 45dB, so you can pump confidently in a silent room or on a work call. It integrates fully with the Momcozy app, allowing you to switch modes, track sessions in real-time, and even get notifications when the collector is full.

Perhaps its most convenient feature is the wireless charging case. This case doesn't just store your pumps; it charges them. A single charge of the case can provide up to 15 pumping sessions or 5 days of use, effectively eliminating cord clutter from your daily routine.

What is Momcozy Air 1 best suitable for?

The Air 1 is the ideal choice for the busy, modern mom who prioritizes discretion. This is for the executive pumping in an open-plan office, the mom running errands, or the parent who wants to pump on a plane or at a social event without anyone knowing. It is our premium, high-tech, "invisible" solution.

Momcozy M9

The Momcozy M9, or Mobile Flow™, is the "smart" pump designed for data-driven moms. Its defining feature is advanced app integration that puts complete control and tracking at your fingertips.

Design, Flange, and Milk Collector

The M9 features a sleek all-in-one design—motor and collector integrated into a single unit that fits discreetly in your bra with no wires or tubes. The transparent Tritan collector is durable, highly transparent, and resistant to over 100 boiling cycles, while DoubleFit™ soft silicone flanges (24mm with 17mm/19mm/21mm inserts) ensure a secure, comfortable seal. The 150ml capacity supports longer sessions without frequent emptying.

Motor, Suction, Modes, and Pumping Settings

The M9 delivers hospital-grade suction up to -300mmHg with a 3rd-gen motor operating whisper-quiet at under 42dB. Through the app, access 15 suction levels, personalized preferences, plus 2 professional modes (Milk Relief™ and Milk Boost™) and 3 standard modes. The app automatically tracks duration, output, and production trends, with alerts when sessions complete. A 12-minute quick charge provides power for one full pumping session.

What is Momcozy M9 best suitable for?

Ideal for tech-savvy moms who want optimization through data, working moms needing smart tracking and reminders, moms building supply who want to monitor trends, and anyone who prefers app-based control over manual settings.

Momcozy M6

The Momcozy M6, or Mobile Style™, balances ergonomic comfort, sleek design, and straightforward simplicity. It's built for moms who want reliable, efficient pumping without complicated features—just stylish functionality that works.

Design, Flange, and Milk Collector

The M6's streamlined, ergonomic design stays nearly invisible under clothing, tested on over 1,000 moms to ensure discreet, comfortable all-day wear. The all-in-one construction integrates motor and collector into a lightweight unit (10.12 oz) that won't weigh you down. Soft silicone flanges adapt to your breast shape for a secure seal, while the 6.09 oz capacity handles generous output. With only 4 accessories to wash, cleanup is remarkably simple.

Motor, Suction, Modes, and Pumping Settings

The M6 features a 2nd-generation motor delivering powerful suction from -285 to -300mmHg with 3 modes (Stimulation, Expression, Mixed) and 9 adjustable levels. The optimized pumping rhythm—perfected through feedback from 1,100+ moms—balances gentle suction with natural frequency for comfortable, effective sessions. Simple button controls make adjustments effortless, with no app required. The 180-minute battery provides 5-6 sessions per charge, supporting full-day freedom.

What is Momcozy M6 best suitable for?

Perfect for moms who value simplicity and ease of use, appreciate stylish ergonomic design, want straightforward controls without app connectivity, and need comfortable all-day wearability. Ideal for busy schedules requiring a "just works" solution.

Momcozy M5 Smart

The Momcozy M5 Smart is our upgraded flagship comfort pump, combining our famous "baby-mouth" suction with new smart technology. It features a unique horizontal pumping angle that mimics a baby's natural latch, offering a gentle and pain-free experience that you can now control entirely from your phone.

Design, Flange, and Milk Collector

The M5 Smart uses a horizontal angle inspired by how babies naturally nurse, which helps reduce discomfort and increases milk flow. Weighing only 8 ounces, it is 1/3 lighter than most pumps and fits invisibly inside your bra with no wires or tubes. The soft silicone flanges (24mm with 17mm/19mm/21mm inserts) adapt comfortably to your shape, and the collector holds a generous 120ml+ of milk.

You can choose from 9 adjustable suction levels, all while the pump stays whisper-quiet (under 50dB). The biggest upgrade is the Momcozy App connectivity, allowing you to track milk volume and control your settings from your smartphone. The battery lasts for 6-7 sessions (100-120 minutes) and includes a 30-minute auto shut-off for safety.

What is Momcozy M5 Smart best suitable for?

The M5 Smart is perfect for tech-savvy moms who want to track their breastfeeding journey, moms with sensitive nipples who need a gentle touch, and anyone wanting a lightweight, truly hands-free solution that's easy to use anywhere.

Momcozy V Series Breast Pumps

The V Series features a unique separated-motor design with tubing to connect the motor and milk collector. The defining characteristic of this series is its design: the motor is a separate, portable unit that connects to the in-bra collection cups via slim, discreet tubing.

Why this design? It's a breakthrough in physics. By moving the heavy motor off the breast, the in-bra collection cups become incredibly lightweight and comfortable. It also allows us to use a much larger, more powerful motor for superior performance.

Momcozy V1 Pro - Hospital grade suction breast pump

The
Momcozy V1 Pro
is our powerhouse and only true hospital-grade pump. Its breakthrough separated-motor design delivers maximum suction power for moms who need serious efficiency to establish or maintain full milk supply.

Design, Flange, and Milk Collector

The V1 Pro's revolutionary design separates the motor from the collection system—a portable motor unit connects to lightweight in-bra cups via slim, flexible tubing. This separation is transformative: removing the heavy motor makes the cups incredibly comfortable for extended wear while allowing for a larger, more powerful motor. The DoubleFit™ soft silicone flanges (24mm with 17mm/19mm/21mm inserts) ensure proper fit, while integrated collectors prevent milk backflow for hygienic collection.

Motor, Suction, Modes, and Pumping Settings

The V1 Pro delivers genuine hospital-grade suction up to -300mmHg—the same power found in clinical pumps. The 3rd-generation motor offers 3 fine-tuned rhythms that mimic baby's suckling patterns at different hunger levels, plus 15 adjustable suction levels for complete customization. The 2300mAh battery supports up to 9 sessions per charge, ensuring reliable performance throughout your day without constant recharging.

What is Momcozy V1 Pro best suitable for?

Ideal for exclusively pumping (EP) moms, moms of twins or multiples needing maximum efficiency, moms building or increasing supply through power pumping, and anyone requiring hospital-grade performance with mobility freedom.

Momcozy V2 Pro - Portable breast pump

The Momcozy V2 Pro features the same innovative separated-motor design as the V1 Pro, optimized for ultimate portability. It delivers powerful, efficient suction in a whisper-quiet, ultra-compact package designed for busy, on-the-go moms.

Design, Flange, and Milk Collector

Like the V1 Pro, the V2 Pro uses a separated-motor design with a lightweight, pocket-sized motor unit connecting to in-bra collection cups via slim tubing. The motor is exceptionally compact and portable, easily slipping into purses or pockets. The lightweight cups remain comfortable under clothing for discreet pumping anywhere. DoubleFit™ soft silicone flanges (24mm with 17mm/19mm/21mm inserts) provide secure, leak-free seals, while integrated collectors ensure hygienic milk collection.

Motor, Suction, Modes, and Pumping Settings

The V2 Pro delivers strong suction up to -288mmHg—powerful enough for efficient milk expression while operating at whisper-quiet levels under 48dB. It offers 3 pumping modes (including milk supply building and stimulation) and 9 adjustable suction levels, giving ample customization for comfort and efficiency. The ultra-quiet operation makes it perfect for pumping in shared spaces, during meetings, or while traveling without drawing attention.

What is Momcozy V2 Pro best suitable for?

Perfect for working moms returning to the office needing efficient pumping during breaks, moms frequently on-the-go requiring portable power, moms valuing discretion in shared spaces, and anyone wanting strong performance in a lighter, quieter package than traditional hospital-grade pumps.

Momcozy V3 — Plug-In Hospital-Grade Breast Pump

The

Momcozy V3

is a plug-in hospital-grade pump built for serious supply work at home. Its Dual-Pump Dual-Control design runs two independent channels so each breast gets its own setting, and

SoftStart™

ramps suction up gradually to protect sensitive nipples. It reaches about

-270 mmHg

and ships with five built-in rhythms — Cozy Flow, Power Pumping, Milk Boost, Lactation Starter, and Deep Emptying — all adjustable across 15 levels in the app. A closed system and roughly 4 hours of battery backup keep sessions uninterrupted, and optional wearable cups add hands-free freedom.

What is Momcozy V3 best suitable for?

The V3 suits exclusively pumping moms, moms of multiples, and anyone building or rebuilding supply who wants consistent hospital-grade power at home. It is the "big host" anchor of a two-pump setup: pair it with a wearable like the Air 1 or W1 for life outside the house.

Momcozy V3 Pro — Cordless Hospital-Grade Breast Pump

The

Momcozy V3 Pro

keeps everything moms love about the V3 and cuts the cord. It is a

cordless, rechargeable

hospital-grade pump with the same Dual-Pump Dual-Control power and five built-in rhythms, plus

StableFlow™ smart pressure stabilization

and adaptive suction that hold consistent vacuum as the milk flows. A brightness-adaptive night light and a premium waterproof carrying bag make it ready for bedroom sessions and travel alike.

What is Momcozy V3 Pro best suitable for?

The V3 Pro is for moms who want hospital-grade performance without being tied to a wall — perfect as the at-home "big host" that also travels. Like the V3, it pairs naturally with a wearable pump for daytime outings.

Momcozy S Series Breast Pumps

The S Series is our "Classic Wearable" family. These are the beloved, reliable pumps that made Momcozy a top-selling brand in North America. In this design, the motor sits directly on top of the milk collector, creating a simple, compact, and highly effective wearable unit. They are celebrated for their powerful suction, ease of use, and fantastic value.

Ideal for moms who want a reliable, customizable workhorse pump with clear visual feedback, moms seeking strong suction and efficiency at an excellent value, and those who prefer straightforward controls with LED display over app connectivity.

It's designed to give you more pumping sessions on a single charge than ever before. This makes it the perfect "go-bag" pump, a reliable backup, or the primary choice for a busy mom who doesn't have time to be tethered to a charger.

What is Momcozy S9 Pro best suitable for?

Perfect for busy moms who need extended battery life without frequent charging, moms wanting a reliable backup or travel pump, and anyone seeking a dependable, no-fuss wearable pump at the best value in our collection.

Start with the setup most moms wish they'd known sooner: a

big host pump at home plus a wearable on the go
. A full-size pump like the

V3

or

V3 Pro

delivers hospital-grade suction and complete sessions at your nightstand, while a wearable such as the

Air 1

or

W1

keeps you consistent at work, in the car, or on a trip. They are teammates, not rivals — together they cover every hour of your day.

How to Clean and Care for Your Momcozy Breast Pump

Clean pump parts that touch milk after every use, and sanitize daily. Good hygiene protects your baby and keeps suction strong — see the

CDC's breast-pump hygiene guidance
.

After every use:

disassemble flanges, valves, membranes, and collectors; rinse in cool water; wash in a dedicated basin with warm soapy water; rinse; air-dry on a clean paper towel.

Once a day:

sanitize by boiling, steam, or UV. The motor and tubing (V Series) are never washed.

Replace on schedule:

valves and membranes every 2–4 weeks, diaphragms every 1–2 months, and V Series tubing every 3–6 months. Worn silicone is the most common cause of lost suction — not a defect.

How do I troubleshoot common Momcozy breast pump issues?

Most pump problems trace back to a few easy fixes. If you hit a snag, work through these first — for safety background, see the

FDA's breast-pump notes
:

Low or dropping suction:

check flange fit, then inspect valves and membranes for stretches or tears and replace them. A loose collection cup or cracked part also leaks pressure.

Unusual noise or vibration:

re-seat the motor and tubing (V Series) and confirm parts are fully locked in.

Pump won't start / auto shut-off:

charge fully, clean the charging contacts, and confirm the lid or sensor isn't blocked.

Skin discomfort:

re-measure your flange size; pain usually means the wrong fit, not the pump.

If the motor itself fails, that is a warranty matter — email

with your proof of purchase. Many "fixes" are just worn silicone parts, which are inexpensive to replace and not covered by warranty.

How to choose the right flange size for Momcozy breast pumps?

This is the single most important factor for a comfortable and efficient pumping experience. An
incorrect flange size
is the number one cause of pain and can reduce your milk output.

The Golden Rule: Measure your nipple, then add 1-3mm.

Here is the correct way to measure:

Stimulate
: Gently stimulate your nipple so it perks up (do not measure a flat nipple).

Measure
: Using the nipple ruler included in your Momcozy pump set, find the hole that your nipple fits through snugly without being squeezed. Alternatively, use a ruler to measure the diameter (the width) of the base of your nipple in millimeters (mm). Do not include your areola.

Calculate
: Take your nipple measurement and add 1 to 3 millimeters to find your ideal flange size. For example, if your nipple base measures 21mm, your ideal flange size is 24mm. If your nipple measures 18mm, you should use a 21mm flange insert.

Check Both
: Your nipples may be different sizes, so be sure to measure both!

How to clean Momcozy breast pumps?

Proper hygiene is essential for your baby's health.

The Golden Rule
: Any part that comes into contact with breast milk (flanges, valves, membranes, milk collectors) must be cleaned after every single use. The pump motor and tubing (for V-series) never get washed.

After Every Use
: Disassemble all milk-contacting parts.

Rinse them in cool running water immediately to remove milk residue.

Wash gently by hand in a dedicated wash basin (not the sink) with warm, soapy water.

Rinse all parts thoroughly.

Air Dry completely on a clean paper towel or drying rack. Do not use a cloth towel, as it can transfer germs.

Once Per Day
: All washed parts should be sterilized at least once every 24 hours. You can do this by boiling the parts, using a steam sterilizer, or using an all-in-one washer/sterilizer/dryer like the Momcozy KleanPal Pro.

The "Fridge Hack"
: In a pinch, you can place your used, unwashed pump parts in a sealed, clean bag and store them in the refrigerator. This is acceptable for up to 4 hours between sessions, but it is not a replacement for cleaning. You must still wash and sterilize all parts at least once per day.
